resource: chase refused-cell memory per chasing player (cells the Movement owner refused a chase step into as Blocked)
allocation_impact: Runtime-only and bounded before retention: a ninth Blocked cell evicts the oldest; each cell leaves the search after 2,000 ms (TTL, as the RANGED-0 §8 failed-search wait); a target or mode change clears the memory. Any other refusal only drops the route and remembers nothing.
boundary_tests: max+1=9: the same test blocks nine cells and keeps the newest eight, the oldest evicted; at 2,000 ms every cell expires
notes: RANGED-0 §8 CHASE-1: the Movement owner alone judges passability from committed facts (a blocking item has no in-memory projection), so the search avoids a cell it just refused as Blocked for 2,000 ms. Registered by LOOP-COMBAT-MODES-1.
